name: microsoft-mail-autoreply
description: Dockerized Microsoft Graph mailbox auto-reply system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @autoreply/shared && npm run build -w @autoreply/web && npm run build -w @autoreply/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @autoreply/api" "npm run dev -w @autoreply/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @autoreply/shared && npm run typecheck -w @autoreply/api && npm run typecheck -w @autoreply/web
